name: Byhealth Co., Ltd
summary: Byhealth Co., Ltd, together with its subsidiaries, provides dietary supplements in China, Hong Kong, Australia, and internationally. It offers protein powder; collagen; bone health products, including glucosamine, chondroitin, and calcium tablets; probiotics; capsules; and multivitamins under the By-Health, Jianlidu, LifeSpace, and other brand names. The company also engages in scenic area tourism management; real estate; trade and investment; sale of food; trademark management; and OTC licensing and outsourced processing activities.
